# Renaissance Labs Mathematics

> A map of all 63 areas of mathematics (MSC2020) with Lean/Mathlib formalization coverage, and Lean environments for training and evaluating proving.

## Data
- https://math.renaissancelabs.eu/data/areas.json
- https://math.renaissancelabs.eu/data/coverage.json
- https://math.renaissancelabs.eu/data/environments.json
